Stephen McCranie

FACEBOOK TWITTER HOMEPAGE BLOG

McCranie is a cartoonist with a mission to make comics that point to a world beyond our world. He's worked in the comics industry for many years, from self-publishing to drawing graphic novels for a major publisher. Check out his children's series, Mal and Chad; and his comic essay, Brick by Brick.
